SELECT 
    bp.player_id,
    SUM(bp.triple) as total_triples
FROM batting_postseason bp
WHERE bp.player_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT player_id 
    FROM batting_postseason 
    WHERE league_id = 'NL'
    INTERSECT
    SELECT DISTINCT player_id 
    FROM batting_postseason 
    WHERE round = 'WS'
)
GROUP BY bp.player_id
ORDER BY total_triples IS NULL, total_triples DESC
LIMIT 10
